rollback_evidence: Used only by the poe-cycle operation on EOS (1.0.12 eos port maintenance E07): 'poe disabled', a pause, then 'no poe disabled' on one Ethernet port behind the timed safeguard session of EOS. Not measured: cEOS has no PoE hardware and answers '% Unavailable command (not supported on this hardware platform)' for poe disabled and show poe (verification record, probe2), which Admin turns into poe_not_capable before any write. Command syntax ('poe disabled', 'no poe disabled', Interface-Ethernet Configuration) and the layout of show poe interface N (Privileged EXEC; PSE Enabled True/False, Port State such as powered) come from the Arista EOS manual, Ethernet Ports (fixtures/eos_eos_port_maintenance/PROVENANCE.md). The write account reads show poe; the operation waits at most 15 s for the power to go off and, when the port was powered before, at most 60 s of pauses for powered again, and reports the observed state.
